Meanwhile, Ethereum Layer 2 Aztec [gets](https://www.theblock.co/news/defi/2026-11-03-ethereum-l2-aztec-tierra-v6-upgrade-private-apps-432399) an upgrade and Justin Sun [seeks](https://www.theblock.co/news/regulation/2026-11-03-justin-sun-sanctions-world-liberty-uae-ties-wlfi-432439) sanctions against World Liberty Financial.

Binance said hackers used a fake job interview, malware, and a compromised internal AI tool to gain access to its wallet infrastructure and steal $6.34 billion in digital assets.

81906.subject: Hackers stole $6.3b from Binance. We’re tracking exchange flows
81906.body:
View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/5fe102f5-8ba2-4584-a1ba-0109facdf9c3/Top_banner_Flare_report.jpg?t=1793724752)
Follow image link: (https://defillama.com/research/report/how-flare-uses-data-to-expand-what-capital-can-do)
Caption: 

In the span of about 20 minutes, hackers stole $6.3b from Binance’s hot wallets on Friday, resulting in the largest crypto hack on record.

Binance froze withdrawals for roughly 45 hours. Stablecoin issuers froze $3b of USDT & USDC.

Track Live Binance Reserves (https://defillama.com/exchange/binance?section=reserves&includeOwnTokens=true)

Since withdrawals resumed, users have withdrawn over $6.4b. 7d Net inflows for the world’s largest crypto exchange currently sit at -$12b.

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/961bc03b-856f-4581-ada3-2a23cfce4bab/image.png?t=1793719794)
Follow image link: (https://defillama.com/exchange/binance?section=reserves&includeOwnTokens=true)
Caption: 

The attackers gained access through a compromised employee computer.

An exploiter’s wallet supplied $60m USDT on Aave and borrowed $44m of WETH, leading to a temporary freeze of Aave’s v3 & v4 lending markets. Markets were unfrozen shortly after.

Stablecoin market cap [fell to its lowest level](https://defillama.com/stablecoins) since October 2025, but there’s currently no sign of stablecoin or lending stress. Other major exchanges have seen [net inflows](https://defillama.com/cexs) over the last 7 days.

After two days of net outflows following the hack, Binance saw nearly $3b in inflows today.

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/e0b46f99-b472-4af7-91e4-ebb0e00d6d7e/binance-inflows-by-token_2026-11-03__2_.png?t=1793718372)
Follow image link: (https://defillama.com/exchange/binance?section=reserves&includeOwnTokens=true)
Caption: 

These outflows were about 8% of Binance’s reserves at their peak: relatively manageable compared to Bybit’s hack in February 2025 that was 36% of reserves. Binance used about half of its $1b SAFU fund and corporate funds to cover the losses. 

Read [Binance’s response update here](https://x.com/binance/status/2117626126214504729?a=q_HDvHN-hGVLRXynk6k&s=20).

Stablecoins make up over 65% of the $6.3b in net outflows from [Binance’s tracked wallets](https://defillama.com/exchange/binance?includeOwnTokens=true&section=reserves) since withdrawals resumed. 

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/68c2703d-e100-4f8a-a3ef-4a0697c22b80/binance-tracked-wallet-net-outflow-by-asset-nov-1-to-nov-3-14-00-utc-snapshot_2026-11-03.png?t=1793720073)
